head: €1.9 billion in the bank.
It wasn’t there.
slides.sub: How Germany’s payments star collapsed in a week.

image.label: An empty bank vault with its door open
image.brief: 문이 열린 텅 빈 은행 금고. 차가운 형광등 빛, 바닥에 서류 한 장. 은행 로고 없음.

head: A German tech star
in the DAX.
body: Wirecard, based near Munich, handled card payments for online shops and merchants. Its reported revenue and profits grew year after year.
In September 2018, it joined the DAX, Germany’s top stock index, replacing Commerzbank, one of the country’s biggest banks.

image.label: A glass office building near Munich at night
image.brief: 밤의 뮌헨 근교 유리 외벽 사무실 건물. 불 켜진 층들, 2010년대 후반 분위기. 실제 회사 로고 없음.

slides.label: Wirecard’s peak stock market value in 2018
body: Investors saw Europe’s answer to Silicon Valley. Questions about its accounts had been raised as early as 2008, but the company kept dismissing critics, and the share price kept climbing.

image.label: A rising stock chart on trading screens
image.brief: 트레이딩 화면 위로 가파르게 오르는 주가 그래프. 푸른 화면 빛. 실제 종목명 없음.

head: The profits came from
partners far away.
body: Much of its profit was booked through third-party partners in Asia and the Middle East that processed payments on its behalf. Outsiders found that business hard to see.
In 2019, the Financial Times reported suspected false accounting in Wirecard’s Singapore office.

image.label: A newspaper on a desk in a dim newsroom
image.brief: 어두운 편집국 책상 위 신문과 메모. 기자는 뒷모습 실루엣. 실제 신문 제호 없음.

head: You’re the regulator.
What do you do?
body: A national champion stands accused by a foreign newspaper. Its shares are crashing, and the company says short sellers are attacking it.

options.text: Open a deep probe of the company’s own accounts
options.feedback: This could hurt a flagship company if the reports were wrong, and it takes time and expertise. Keep swiping.

options.text: Leave it to the company’s auditor, who has signed off for years
options.feedback: It spares you a fight, but it trusts the same checks that are now in question. Keep swiping.

options.text: Protect the stock and look into the critics
options.feedback: It calms the market fast, but it sends a signal about whose side you are on. Keep swiping.

image.label: A regulator’s desk with two thick files
image.brief: 감독기관 사무실 책상 위 두꺼운 서류철 두 개. 창밖은 흐린 독일 도시. 인물은 실루엣.

head: The watchdog turned
on the critics.
body: In February 2019, Germany’s financial regulator, BaFin, banned new short bets against Wirecard for two months. It also filed a criminal complaint against the FT journalists. Prosecutors later dropped the case.
To many investors, the message was clear: the company was the victim.

image.label: A spotlight falling on a reporter’s empty chair
image.brief: 편집국의 빈 기자 의자 위로 떨어지는 스포트라이트. 긴장감 있는 어두운 톤.

head: The special audit
found no proof.
body: Under pressure, Wirecard hired KPMG for a special audit. Its April 2020 report said it could not verify that much of the partner business was real.
Then its long-time auditor, EY, refused to sign the 2019 accounts.

image.label: Stacks of audit binders with blank pages
image.brief: 감사 서류철이 쌓여 있고 펼쳐진 페이지는 비어 있는 장면. 차가운 회색 톤.

slides.label: said to sit in trust accounts at two Philippine banks
body: In June 2020, both banks said the documents showing the money were not genuine. Days later, Wirecard admitted the cash most likely did not exist.

image.label: A bank statement with the balance blanked out
image.brief: 잔액 칸이 비어 있는 은행 잔고 증명서 클로즈업. 실제 은행명·로고 없음.

head: A DAX company,
gone in a week.
body: CEO Markus Braun resigned and was arrested; he went on trial in Munich and denies the charges. Chief operating officer Jan Marsalek fled and remains wanted.
On June 25, 2020, Wirecard filed for insolvency, the first DAX member ever to do so.

image.label: An empty office floor with chairs pushed back
image.brief: 의자가 밀려나 있는 텅 빈 사무실 층. 꺼진 모니터들, 2020년 분위기.

head: Everyone trusted
someone else to check.
body: Investors trusted the auditor. The auditor trusted documents from partners and banks. The regulator trusted the company’s story. A shining reputation made each check feel unnecessary.
Growth that outsiders could not see or test was the warning sign, not proof of success.

image.label: A chain of hands passing a sealed envelope
image.brief: 봉인된 봉투를 손에서 손으로 넘기는 사슬. 누구도 봉투를 열지 않는 구도. 얼굴 없음.

head: Treat critics as data,
not as enemies.
body: The louder a success story gets, the more its key numbers deserve a direct check.
**Try it today:** pick the one number your business relies on most. Could you trace it back to cash or a real customer yourself?

image.label: A single magnifying glass over a ledger
image.brief: 장부 위에 놓인 돋보기 하나. 어두운 배경, 따뜻한 조명.

factChecks.note: 2018년 9월 DAX 편입과 Commerzbank 대체는 Deutsche Börse 발표 및 당시 보도로 확인하세요. → [2026-11-02 확인] 2018년 9월 Commerzbank 대체 DAX 편입 확인.
2018년 최고 시가총액은 보도에 따라 약 240억 유로입니다. 카드에는 "more than €20 billion"으로만 적었습니다. → [2026-11-02 확인] 최고 시가총액 240억 유로는 미확인(DAX 편입 시 약 200억 유로 보도). 카드의 '€20B+'는 보도 범위 안.
2019년 2월 BaFin의 2개월 공매도 금지와 FT 기자들에 대한 형사 고발(이후 검찰이 수사 종결)은 BaFin 발표와 독일 연방의회 조사위원회 보고서로 확인하세요.
KPMG 특별감사 보고서(2020년 4월 28일)가 제3자 파트너 사업의 매출과 수익을 충분히 검증하지 못했다고 밝힌 내용은 보고서 원문과 당시 보도로 확인하세요.

2020년 6월 18일 EY의 감사의견 거절, 필리핀 두 은행(BDO, BPI)이 문서가 가짜라고 밝힌 점, 6월 22일 회사가 19억 유로가 존재하지 않을 가능성이 높다고 발표한 점은 Wirecard 공시와 은행 성명으로 확인하세요. → [2026-11-02 확인] BDO·BPI가 Wirecard는 고객이 아니라고 밝힘, 6월 22일 19억 유로가 존재하지 않을 가능성이 높다고 발표 확인.
Markus Braun 사임(6월 19일)·체포, Jan Marsalek 도주(수배 중), 6월 25일 파산 신청과 'DAX 기업 최초 파산'은 당시 보도 기준입니다. Braun 재판은 진행 중이며 혐의를 부인하므로 유죄를 단정하지 않았습니다. → [2026-11-02 확인] 2020년 6월 25일 파산 신청, DAX 기업 최초 확인.
2008년 주주단체(SdK)가 회계 의문을 제기한 사실은 당시 보도로 확인하세요. 카드에는 구체적 내용 없이 "questions about its accounts"로만 적었습니다.
